summary: Initial inclusion of derived_sgmc_faults_100m.tif (USGS SGMC mapped bedrock fault raster, 83,593 positive pixels) inside HMCS caused HistGradientBoostingClassifier to concentrate dots along pre-mapped SGMC bedrock traces, triggering our automated post-placement 3-px overlap gate (>0.70) against three SGMC-heavy peer rasters despite near-zero Spearman rank correlation (rho = 0.021-0.041).
scientific_resolution: Removed derived_sgmc_faults_100m.tif (which is a pre-Quaternary bedrock fault map rather than a blind geophysical/geothermal sensor, and historically underperformed live in GEMSDOE30 MSDB1 at 0.1462 because Mesozoic/Tertiary mountain-block thrusts are not active Quaternary basin geothermal conduits). Replaced with 100% sensor-derived updip potential-field + drainage-orthogonal scarp + hydrothermal alteration/upflow concordance (`hmcs_updip_alteration_concordance`).
warning: Historical account; later literal lattice audit overrides any uniqueness or release conclusion.
